description: Looks up any app on the network by name and returns its published specification, expiry, running instances, URLs and a reachability check: probes the shared domain (HTTP) and each instance port (TCP and HTTP) and explains what a 503 means, including when it is expected for non-web apps.

fluxIdPrivateKey.description: WIF private key of the Flux ID that owns the app. Use a dedicated key from flux_generate_keys, never a main wallet key.

paymentPrivateKey.description: WIF private key of the Flux address that pays. Fund it with only what you intend to spend.

ports.description: Ports to probe on instances; needed for private apps whose ports are encrypted.

name: flux_get_app
title: Get a deployed app: spec, status, instances, URLs
